faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes GLS350d use?
faqLeft.a: The GLS350d uses the OM642 - a 3.0-litre V6 diesel. It was fitted to the X166 generation from 2015 to 2019.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes GLS350d engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,800. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my GLS350d?
faqLeft.a: Every X166-generation GLS350d uses the OM642. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM642 GLS350d engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and timing chain components as standard on every OM642 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used GLS350d engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my GLS350d if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a GLS350d engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most GLS350d owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
